title: Trove activity event
description: One line of activity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (or activity/<source>/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl for an imported history): one contiguous span of using a single app and window, or of being away from the keyboard. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

start.description: RFC3339 local time the span began

end.description: RFC3339 local time the span ended

seconds.description: end - start in whole seconds, stored so readers never have to parse timestamps to total a day

app.description: the frontmost app's display name; empty for AFK spans

bundle_id.description: the app's bundle identifier when known

title.description: the frontmost window's title; empty when the sampler lacks Screen Recording

afk.description: true = away from keyboard (no input past the idle threshold); such spans have an empty app
